name: Hyozan Reckoners
description: An allegiance of Toshi and Hidetsugu bound by an oath, later joined by Kobo, Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer.

description_citations.text: "Toshiro Umezawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu kills Boss Uramon's task force except Toshiro Umezawa, whom he agrees to form the Hyozan Reckoners with.
timeline.quote: Hidetsugu killed all the men except Umezawa

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer are forced to join the Hyozan Reckoners after the yuki-onna kill her men.
timeline.quote: Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer were forced to join the Hyozan Reckoners .

citation.text: "Kiku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi, sent with Uramon's hitmen to attack Hidetsugu, convinces the ogre to form the Hyozan Reckoners.
timeline.quote: The ogre killed all the others, but the kanji mage managed to convince him to form an allegiance that became known as the Hyozan Reckoners

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pursuers are killed by the yuki-onna; Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer are forced to join the hyozan; the yuki-onna is imprisoned in a tile.
timeline.quote: The yuki-onna was then imprisoned inside a tile.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi goes to the Heart of Frost, gains the Yuki-Onna's frost power and captures her in a magic disk, forcing Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer into the Hyozan Reckoners.
timeline.quote: then succeeds in gaining the Onna's power of frost and capturing her in a magic disk via a kanji ritual.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Night's Reach calls in Toshi's debt and has him leave the Hyozan Reckoners, though his intentions secretly diverge from hers.
timeline.quote: Night's Reach cashes in on the favor Toshi owes her.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaito stalks a gambler through the crowded Lantern Festival for a Reckoner job.
timeline.quote: It hadn't taken Kaito long to find his target.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: In the Undercity a Reckoner accuses Kaito of stealing his mark, and Kaito talks him down.
timeline.quote: "You stole my mark."

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito reveals he joined the Reckoners to find the man with a metal arm who attacked the emperor.
timeline.quote: If anyone was going to know about a man with a metal arm, it would be Satoru's spies.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Five Hyozan Reckoners led by Nari arrive with Satoru's channeler, revealing they were watching Kaito and that the job was a setup to find Tameshi.
timeline.quote: He hoped you'd lead us to Tameshi."

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: A Reckoner seizes Eiko at swordpoint and Nari demands the kami.
timeline.quote: One of the Reckoners moved quickly, grabbing hold of Eiko and holding a sword against her neck.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Eiko breaks free and the siblings fight the Reckoners back to back while Tameshi fails to make the kami merge with the robot.
timeline.quote: "What happened to 'no weapons'?"

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: The Order of Jukai arrives and battles the Reckoners, letting the group escape with the kami.
timeline.quote: The Order of Jukai had arrived.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Through the drone Kaito sees a chrome monster directing Reckoners to load specimens, with something screaming like a kami inside a container.
timeline.quote: They sounded like kami .

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: A Reckoner smashes the beakers and the warehouse is set ablaze, destroying evidence as the vehicle leaves.
timeline.quote: threw it against the rest of the glass with force.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Takumi presses for more tribute.
timeline.quote: That's a start. What else do you have for us?

citation.text: Reckoner Shakedown (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Reckoners hold yearly restricted auctions at the Dragon's Lair.
timeline.quote: Restricted auctions are held once a year at the Dragon's Lair

citation.text: Reckoner's Bargain (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: On Kamigawa Jin-Gitaxias experiments on kami and devises a way to compleat a planeswalker without removing their soul.
timeline.quote: he successfully devised a way to compleat a planeswalker without removing their soul.

citation.text: "Jin-Gitaxias", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nashi attacks Tezzeret demanding his mother; Tezzeret subdues him, kills his gang and lets him live.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker easily subdued him and killed the other nezumi in his gang.

citation.text: "Nashi", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer recounts how Nashi followed his mother's voice to a carved door, sent drones through, and then went in with friends, after which the door vanished.
timeline.quote: He followed her call to a door covered in strange carvings, one that had no place in Kamigawa.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Nashi blames himself for leading his Reckoner friends to their deaths.
timeline.quote: I came in here with four of the Reckoners I knew from back home.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Nashi follows Tamiyo's voice to a door to Duskmourn and travels through with six friends, trapped for three months.
timeline.quote: he took six of his closest friends, other nezumi Reckoners, and traveled through, where he was trapped for three months.

citation.text: "Nashi", section "Lost on Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orochi attack the party; Choryu escapes on a stream, then drowns the immobilized Kobo with a stream of water, earning the Hyozan Reckoners' revenge.
timeline.quote: he drowned him with a mighty stream of water directed into his face

citation.text: "Choryu", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi tricks Marrow-Gnawer and Kiku into the Hyozan Reckoners; bound by the oath they help him neutralize Uramon and steal her Shadow Gate.
timeline.quote: Toshi tricked Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer into joining the Hyozan Reckoners gang

citation.text: "Marrow-Gnawer", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds the chip in Tameshi's laboratory and is attacked by Jin-Gitaxias and the Reckoners; Tamiyo and the Wanderer save him.
timeline.quote: He was saved by Tamiyo and the returned Wanderer.

citation.text: "Reality Chip", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: When the leader of the Hyozan Reckoners still didn't speak

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

relations.quote: Kaito had been doing jobs for the Hyozan Reckoners for nearly a year.
